products.name: Museum Loan Condition Desk
products.product: A focused museum object loan condition tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small museums, historic sites, and nonprofit collections teams
products.problem: Incoming and outgoing condition notes, packing, locations, display requirements, approvals, and return obligations are distributed across files.
products.valueProposition: Turns museum object loan condition tracking into a visible operating queue so every loan object has a current condition, custody, location, requirement, and due-action record.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets museum object loan condition tracking software, museum object loan condition tracking tracker, museum object loan condition tracking template, and museum object loan condition tracking checklist searches.

products.name: Exhibit Maintenance Handoff

products.valueProposition: Turns museum exhibit maintenance tracking into a visible operating queue so every exhibit issue has an appropriate owner, treatment boundary, visitor plan, and verified closure.
